reviews.title: High quality case fan. 6 months use, no bearing noise.
reviews.comment: Been using them for 6 months now. Not a single bearing noise. They are honestly quality and move plenty of air for about a fraction of the price of other fans. They look good in a black pc case, I ended up putting them at the bottom of my NZXT H6 Flow and they do not look out of place. I've been building pc's for almost 7 years now and I almost always get a pc case fan that already has grinding noises coming from the bearings.
reviews.author: Mason P.

reviews.title: Incredible Value for quality
reviews.comment: Amazing and quiet. Built with quality especially at this value price point.
reviews.author: Blake Harrill

reviews.title: Great budget fan, silent
reviews.comment: I've been using this as an exhaust fan from a mid-tower case for about 3 months and it's been reliable and quiet and it moves a ton of air.  I didn't want a bunch of RGB, so the lack of color is great.  Temps in the case using an AIO have been great.
reviews.author: JT

reviews.title: You get more for these
reviews.comment: These fans blow . They are cool. They get louder when they get busy , but are nice at idle speeds. But for the money!! Hard to beat . They have rubber pads
reviews.author: Sharkface
